description: A man  only eats vegetable and fruits. A serving of vegetables contains 2 units of vitamins and 3 units of minerals. A serving of fruit contains 4 units of vitamins and 1 unit of minerals. He wants to eat at least 20 units of vitamins and 30 units of minerals. If vegetables cost $3 per serving and fruits cost $5 per serving, how many servings of each should he eat to minimize his cost?

VegetableVitamins.definition: Amount of vitamins in one serving of vegetables

VegetableMinerals.definition: Amount of minerals in one serving of vegetables

FruitVitamins.definition: Amount of vitamins in one serving of fruits

FruitMinerals.definition: Amount of minerals in one serving of fruits

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of servings of vegetables and fruits while meeting the minimum vitamin and mineral requirements"

constraints.description: 2 * (number of vegetable servings) + 4 * (number of fruit servings) must be greater than or equal to 20
3 * (number of vegetable servings) + 1 * (number of fruit servings) must be greater than or equal to 30
Number of vegetable servings must be greater than or equal to 0
Number of fruit servings must be greater than or equal to 0
